grade_notes.measured: read from bytes: ov06.bin (table, code facts) or the character's .amt (keys)
grade_notes.inferred: follows from measured pieces, not traced end to end; see the research note
grade_notes.lead: a reading with an untraced gate; do not build on it
grade_notes.anim: the table's anim is the one 0x02159EF8 hands to 0x02157450 at move start; a per-move handler can change what plays (Yusuke side Y plays 0x28, anim-timing.json)
grade_notes.cancel_start: earliest key + 2, in anim frames from the anchor (frame 0 = anim frame 0); measured where cites.cancel_start names the live check, else inferred; it equals game frames only while the anim clock runs (a charge pause or a mash loop before the key adds frames)
grade_notes.followups: reader targets (ground window: ids 1-6; air window: ids 9-10) whose mask bit is clear; assumes fighter+0xC0 (a second mask, never read statically) has the bit clear; in a chain the masks OR together (route())
grade_notes.special_cancel: a ground cancel window (the F3 flag from the move's ground NoteTrack key) also offers X (id 13) and up X (id 14). Reader 0x0215A720 returns 14 for input & 0x41 == 0x41 and 13 for input & 0x40, after its B/Y and id-11 tests, so a held B or Y shadows X. No mask blocks them: every mask in ids 1-10 has bits 12-14 clear. The window is the normals' (start = earliest ground key + 2, open until the animation ends); an earlier press is buffered in +0xC8. Gates: grounded ([[fighter+0x1A8]+0x10]+0x78 & 2, 0x0215A708) and one SP bar (0x0207834C with cost 1 at 0x0215A524: free if slot+0x5CE or +0x5CF is nonzero, refused at 0 bars). A cancelled X runs in state 9 and C4 becomes all ones, so nothing cancels out of it (terminal). A move needs a ground key: air-key-only moves (Eve and Kakashi up Y, Yusuke up B) and every air window give no special (reader 0x0215A8C0 returns only 9 and 10). Slot ids 9/10 may have ground windows. Not X gates: id 12 (fighter+0xD1, a one-tick dream-attack request) and +0x1CC/+0x1D0 (the active koma slot and its snapshot) only affect the id-12 path (0x0215A590-0x0215A614); id 11 never cancels in (0x0215A4FC). Grade: measured for the code; live-measured for Yusuke B, Y, side Y and up Y (cites.special_cancel: docs/research/feel-captures/yusuke-xcancel-airy-2026-09-25/RESULTS.md and docs/research/feel-captures/yusuke-matrix-2026-09-30/r1/matrix/RESULTS.md), inferred for every other move and character. Side Y is null there: its static start is unresolved (anim conflict), though the live run timed the cancel.
grade_notes.system_followups: see special_cancel: ids 13 and 14 are the special cancels; id 12 and id 11 are not followups of a normal.
